title: Generalised Transportability via Causal Abstractions
abstract: arXiv:2608.15645v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transporting a causal conclusion from a source study population to a target one is a fundamental problem in causal inference. The theory of transportability provides a criterion for when this is possible: given experimental data from the source and observational data from the target, it determines whether a target query is identifiable and does so completely; i.e. if the query can be transported, the criterion finds the exact formula. However, it works one query at a time and returns an expression rather than the value itself. It is also silent in two practically important regimes: when the query is not transportable and when no target data exist at all. To tackle both, we take a model-level perspective grounded in Causal Abstraction theory. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15645v1 公告类型：新 摘要：将因果结论从源研究群体迁移到目标群体是因果推断中的一个基本问题。可迁移性理论为此提供了标准：给定来自源的实验数据和来自目标的观测数据，它确定目标查询是否可识别，并且是完全识别；即，如果查询可迁移，该标准会找到精确的公式。然而，它一次只能处理一个查询，并返回表达式而非数值本身。此外，它在两种实际重要情况下保持沉默：当查询不可迁移时，以及当根本不存在目标数据时。为解决这两个问题，我们采取基于因果抽象理论的模型级视角。源和目标共享变量、图结构和干预，仅在一组已知机制上有所不同，这使得可迁移性成为同层抽象的特例。因此，我们不问……
tldr: 本文通过因果抽象理论将可迁移性推广为模型级特例，解决了传统方法无法处理不可迁移查询和无目标数据时的两大局限。
en_tdlr: This paper generalizes transportability as a model-level special case via causal abstraction, addressing limitations when queries are untransportable or target data are absent.
